description: Speed budget per screen (blueprint 45 E, build section 1: a slow screen fails the build). Every emulator is one offline file; the budget caps its size and how long it takes to show its first screen and to answer a tap on a four-times-slower CPU (a low-cost phone). tests/test_speed_budget.py enforces it; raise a budget only with a reason in the change log.
